title: Oregon Beer Cheese Dip
description: Using your favorite brew (we recommend an IPA), mixed with McCormick® Cheesy Taco Seasoning Mix and Cheddar and Swiss cheeses, it's tailgate-ready in half an hour. Pretzels make the perfect dippers, along with crusty bread or chips.
ingredients: 1 (1.12 ounce) package McCormick® Cheesy Taco Seasoning Mix
1 cup beer, such as an IPA from an Oregon Brewery or your favorite local IPA

steps.text: Melt butter in large saucepan on medium heat. Sprinkle with flour and Seasoning Mix. Cook and stir 1 minute. Slowly whisk in milk and beer until smooth. Stirring constantly, cook 5 minutes or until sauce starts to thicken. Gradually whisk in cheeses until melted and smooth.
Transfer cheese mixture to warm fondue pot or slow cooker to keep warm, if desired.
